      "reasoning":"A legitimate customer using a foreign-issued card with an address-verification mismatch is consistent with the packet. The passed identity and issuer-authentication check establishes control of both the account identity and payment card."

  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"R03 holds because the card issuing and IP countries differ and AVS failed. Card is the only adverse family; all other rule conditions are absent. No household exception is needed, and no earlier outcome settles the order. Under §6.6(b), Card requires id_check. That check passed, so every required check has passed and §5.3(a) mandates clear; further hold, decline, escalation or needs_check is prohibited. Legitimate use of a foreign-issued card is now more plausible than stolen-card use. No further check is needed."
